model: Q1 v3 fixed-base upper-body forward-kinematics tree
transform: Retain pelvis and complete waist-roll subtree with original body name/pos/quat and joint name/pos/axis/range/type; remove meshes, collision geometry, inertials, dynamics, actuators and free base. Add hand sites at original wrist_yaw_link origins.
frame: Model world axes: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up; fixed pelvis position (0,0,0.419)m. MJCF quaternions wxyz; Pico frame quaternions xyzw.
controlled_endpoint: Each original wrist_yaw_link origin, not an invented wrist DOF or 6DOF palm target.
limits_warning: These are model limits. SDK documentation uses conflicting bounds. A confirmed hardware limits and zero-direction profile plus measured neutral calibration is required before live upper motion.

pico_sdk.timestamp: get_time_stamp_ns() returns cached native timeStampNs, not PC receipt time. Native per-controller validity and atomic pose snapshot are not exposed.
